claims_extracted.claim: DEC's 1985 LAT documentation family includes the DECserver 100 Terminal Server and distinguishes its hardware, software installation, operations and user documentation.
The DECserver 100 is an Ethernet terminal-server product whose software is associated with DECnet load-host installation/operation procedures.
claims_extracted.notes: Exact processor/port/Ethernet hardware requires the site-preparation and hardware-installation guide.
